standingCommittees.name: Medical Education
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Strengthening medical learning through student advocacy, peer education, and academic development.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Medical Education empowers medical students to take active ownership of their learning, curriculum design, clinical simulation, and postgraduate preparedness.

standingCommittees.name: Public Health
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Promoting prevention, health literacy, and community engagement to address public health needs.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Public Health addresses regional and national epidemiological challenges through preventive drives, NCD screening clinics, antimicrobial resistance stewardship, and rural outreach.

standingCommittees.name: Sexual & Reproductive Health and Rights
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Fostering informed, inclusive dialogue on sexual and reproductive health, rights, and wellbeing.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights promotes maternal health literacy, cervical cancer awareness, gender-based violence prevention, and youth health advocacy.

standingCommittees.name: Professional Exchange
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Connecting medical students with clinical exchange opportunities and cross-cultural learning.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Professional Exchange facilitates bilateral international hospital clerkships, pre-departure clinical ethics training, and academic medical bilateral exchanges.

standingCommittees.name: Human Rights & Peace
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Championing dignity, health equity, and a culture of peace through education and student action.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Human Rights and Peace advocates for refugee medical support, healthcare access for vulnerable populations, medical ethics, and disaster humanitarian relief.

standingCommittees.name: Research Exchange
standingCommittees.shortDescription: Encouraging scientific curiosity and international collaboration through research exchange.
standingCommittees.fullMission: The Standing Committee on Research Exchange builds foundational biostatistics capabilities, peer-reviewed clinical research cohorts, journal clubs, and international research clerkships.

committeeLeadership.officialTitle: LOCAL OFFICER ON HUMAN RIGHTS & PEACE (LORP)
